title: Corrected Sodium for Hyperglycemia
sources: Hillier TA et al. Am J Med 1999

changelog.change: Initial entry. Ships Hillier (2.4) per the build-spec recommendation.

purpose: True sodium in the setting of hyperglycemia (DKA / HHS) — hyperglycemia pulls water intravascularly and dilutes measured sodium.

interpretation.label: Corrected hyponatremia — a true free-water excess persists after glucose is accounted for
Corrected hypernatremia — significant free-water deficit; anticipate a rise in measured Na as glucose falls with treatment

notes: This app ships the Hillier constant (2.4), which is empirically derived and more accurate at the high glucose levels where this calculation matters. The older Katz constant (1.6) is a theoretical estimate — not offered here to avoid inconsistent results.
